title: nettrace_3gpp_32_423: Add handle of traceRecSession
description:
First step is to utilie "stime" from traceRecSession when exist. After this change more elements under traceRecSession will parsed.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

notes.body:
stime works but lost the parsing of multiple msg per traceRecSession, not sure yet why.

example that doesn't work anymore, first msg of second traceRecSession is not parsed

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<traceCollecFile
    xmlns="http://www.3gpp.org/ftp/specs/archive/32_series/32.423#traceData"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.3gpp.org/ftp/specs/archive/32_series/32.423#traceData">
  <fileHeader fileFormatVersion="32.423 V15.0.0">
    <traceCollec beginTime="2025-08-23T00:30:00,615+05:30"/>
  </fileHeader>
  <traceRecSession stime="2025-08-23T00:30:02,722+05:30">
    <msg function="S1" name="Service request" changeTime="No Value">
      <initiator type="UE"/>
      <target type="MME"/>
      <rawMsg protocol="NAS" version="001">C7B5AAAA</rawMsg>
    </msg>
  </traceRecSession>
  <traceRecSession stime="2025-08-23T00:30:05,955+05:30">
    <msg function="S1" name="Service request" changeTime="No Value">
      <initiator type="UE"/>
      <target type="MME"/>
      <rawMsg protocol="NAS" version="001">C7B5BBBB</rawMsg>
    </msg>
    <msg function="S1" name="Service request" changeTime="No Value">
      <initiator type="UE"/>
      <target type="MME"/>
      <rawMsg protocol="NAS" version="001">C7B5CCCC</rawMsg>
    </msg>
  </traceRecSession>
</traceCollecFile>
```
@AndersBroman , do you got some ideas how it should be done?
